I've completed the clone and fidelity checks. Here's a summary of the work:

**File written to:** `/var/folders/gb/m6478s0n5mx9wqlz8t_c03800000gn/T/gumshoe-agent-run-W7bwLe/clone.html`

**Key decisions:**
- **Design tokens** (via windtailor on `body`, `.theme__header`, `.home__subtitle`, and the CTA button, plus reading the theme's raw CSS custom properties): white page background, `#656565`/`#747474` gray text, `#efe9db` cream announcement bar, `#483535` hover accent. Fonts are the theme's real stack — **Poppins** (body), **Alegreya Sans** uppercase/letter-spaced (headings/nav), **Questrial** (accent) — loaded from Google Fonts and wired into the Tailwind config.
- **Componentized:** product grid card (New Arrivals, 8 items), collection-grid tile (Shop Today, 5 items), logo-bar item (8 brand logos), and footer column block — all confirmed as genuinely repeated, same-purpose fragments by inspection, not just similar shape.
- **Hotlinked, not rehosted:** every product photo, lifestyle photo, and logo uses the live `goodvibesonmain.ca` CDN URL directly, per scope.
- **Flagged as unrecreatable / approximated:**
  - The `#widget2` cross-origin iframe (confirmed absent from raw HTML, JS-injected) — a genuine YouTube embed. I approximated it with the real YouTube thumbnail (`img.youtube.com/vi/asQcvDjkrEo/...`) + a play button linking out to YouTube, and set its height to the exact 900px the live section renders at.
  - The "Get good vibes in your inbox!" popup is a third-party marketing app injection (not in raw HTML, not core theme content) — per the tool guidance on toolbars/cookie-banners/A-B widgets, I intentionally excluded it rather than rebuilding it as if it were page content.
  - The hero slideshow's first image intermittently served two visibly different images across my own fetches (a "guitar player" lifestyle photo vs. a "Summer Vibes Loading" collage) from the *same* CDN URL — this is live CDN edge-cache flakiness on the target site's end, not something a static clone can pin down; I kept the real, current CDN URL.
- **Fidelity check:** screenshotted original vs. clone at 1280×900 viewport across 2 rounds (`original.png`/`original-round2.png` vs `clone-round1.png`/`clone-round2.png`, diffs in `diff-round1.png`/`diff-round2.png`), plus two scoped section diffs (New Arrivals grid, video section). Whole-page odiff sat around 58-60%, but visual inspection showed this was dominated by (a) the intentionally-excluded popup shifting everything below it, and (b) crow-nester's root-selector screenshots capturing the sticky header/popup overlay on top of scoped crops, not real layout mismatches. The New Arrivals grid and video section — my two highest-priority calls — matched well in position, sizing, and imagery once that contamination was accounted for; I corrected a real height bug found this way (video section was 720px vs. the live 900px) and increased New Arrivals section spacing to better match.

resultText:
I've completed the clone and fidelity checks. Here's a summary of the work:

**File written to:** `/var/folders/gb/m6478s0n5mx9wqlz8t_c03800000gn/T/gumshoe-agent-run-W7bwLe/clone.html`

**Key decisions:**
- **Design tokens** (via windtailor on `body`, `.theme__header`, `.home__subtitle`, and the CTA button, plus reading the theme's raw CSS custom properties): white page background, `#656565`/`#747474` gray text, `#efe9db` cream announcement bar, `#483535` hover accent. Fonts are the theme's real stack — **Poppins** (body), **Alegreya Sans** uppercase/letter-spaced (headings/nav), **Questrial** (accent) — loaded from Google Fonts and wired into the Tailwind config.
- **Componentized:** product grid card (New Arrivals, 8 items), collection-grid tile (Shop Today, 5 items), logo-bar item (8 brand logos), and footer column block — all confirmed as genuinely repeated, same-purpose fragments by inspection, not just similar shape.
- **Hotlinked, not rehosted:** every product photo, lifestyle photo, and logo uses the live `goodvibesonmain.ca` CDN URL directly, per scope.
- **Flagged as unrecreatable / approximated:**
  - The `#widget2` cross-origin iframe (confirmed absent from raw HTML, JS-injected) — a genuine YouTube embed. I approximated it with the real YouTube thumbnail (`img.youtube.com/vi/asQcvDjkrEo/...`) + a play button linking out to YouTube, and set its height to the exact 900px the live section renders at.
  - The "Get good vibes in your inbox!" popup is a third-party marketing app injection (not in raw HTML, not core theme content) — per the tool guidance on toolbars/cookie-banners/A-B widgets, I intentionally excluded it rather than rebuilding it as if it were page content.
  - The hero slideshow's first image intermittently served two visibly different images across my own fetches (a "guitar player" lifestyle photo vs. a "Summer Vibes Loading" collage) from the *same* CDN URL — this is live CDN edge-cache flakiness on the target site's end, not something a static clone can pin down; I kept the real, current CDN URL.
- **Fidelity check:** screenshotted original vs. clone at 1280×900 viewport across 2 rounds (`original.png`/`original-round2.png` vs `clone-round1.png`/`clone-round2.png`, diffs in `diff-round1.png`/`diff-round2.png`), plus two scoped section diffs (New Arrivals grid, video section). Whole-page odiff sat around 58-60%, but visual inspection showed this was dominated by (a) the intentionally-excluded popup shifting everything below it, and (b) crow-nester's root-selector screenshots capturing the sticky header/popup overlay on top of scoped crops, not real layout mismatches. The New Arrivals grid and video section — my two highest-priority calls — matched well in position, sizing, and imagery once that contamination was accounted for; I corrected a real height bug found this way (video section was 720px vs. the live 900px) and increased New Arrivals section spacing to better match.
